sloka: कामाद्वा तात लोभाद्वा मात्रा तुभ्यमिदं कृतम् ।न तन्मनसि कर्त्तव्यं वर्त्तितव्यं च मातृवत् ॥ २.११२.१९॥
transliteration: kāmādvā tāta lobhādvā mātrā tubhyamidaṁ kṛtam ।na tanmanasi karttavyaṁ varttitavyaṁ ca mātṛvat ॥ 2.112.19॥

translations.english: Dear brother, whether out of affection or greed, your mother has done this for your sake. It should not agitate your mind. You should conduct yourself as one should towards one's mother.
